verdict.rationale: The pack only implies custom data modeling. A community user calls Salesforce 'a king' of customization (salesforce-comm-6), and developer tooling such as scratch orgs, Apex tests and the CLI points to a programmable platform beyond the built-in Lead/Account/Contact/Opportunity objects (salesforce-docs-22). No item explicitly documents custom objects, custom fields or relationship types. Missing for 10: first-party docs on creating custom objects, custom field definitions, lookup/master-detail relationship modeling, and hands-on corroboration of custom schema work.
